lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Long long ago, there was a king.
lines.chinese: 很久很久以前，有一位国王。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He liked new clothes.
lines.chinese: 他喜欢新衣服。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: One day, two men visited the king.
lines.chinese: 一天，两个男人来拜见国王。

lines.speaker: Two men
lines.english: My king, we can make new clothes for you.
lines.chinese: 我的国王，我们可以为您做新衣服。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: The king was happy.
lines.chinese: 国王很高兴。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: The two men showed the king his new clothes.
lines.chinese: 两个男人向国王展示了他的新衣服。

lines.speaker: Two men
lines.english: My king, please try on these magic clothes. Clever people can see them. Foolish people can't see them.
lines.chinese: 我的国王，请试穿这些神奇的衣服。聪明的人能看见它们。愚蠢的人看不见它们。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: The king walked through the city in his new clothes.
lines.chinese: 国王穿着他的新衣服走过城市。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: There were a lot of people in the street.
lines.chinese: 街上有很多人。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: They looked at the king and shouted, "What beautiful clothes!"
lines.chinese: 他们看着国王，大声喊道："多漂亮的衣服啊！"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: A little boy pointed at the king and laughed, "Ha! Ha! The king isn't wearing any clothes!"
lines.chinese: 一个小男孩指着国王笑道："哈哈！国王没穿衣服！"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Miss Fox and her students are playing a game. They are telling a story. Each student says one sentence. Miss Fox starts.
lines.chinese: 狐狸小姐和她的学生们在玩游戏。他们在讲故事。每个学生说一句话。狐狸小姐先开始。

lines.speaker: Miss Fox
lines.english: Long long ago, there was a mountain.
lines.chinese: 很久以前，有一座山。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: There was a house on the mountain.
lines.chinese: 山上有一座房子。

lines.speaker: Willy
lines.english: An old man and a little boy lived in the house.
lines.chinese: 一位老人和一个小男孩住在房子里。

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.english: The old man told the boy a story.
lines.chinese: 老人给男孩讲了一个故事。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It is Bobby's turn. He is thinking hard.
lines.chinese: 轮到博比了。他正在努力思考。

lines.speaker: Miss Fox
lines.english: Bobby, what's next?
lines.chinese: 博比，接下来呢？

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Long long ago, there was ... a mountain.
lines.chinese: 很久以前，有……一座山。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Ha! Ha! We have to start the story again.
lines.chinese: 哈哈！我们不得不从头开始讲故事。
